name: clash.video-enhance
summary: Generic, headless video-enhancement Generator dispatched by Host-frozen modelRoute; recognizes no Provider by name.
rules: This Generator declares semanticShape=video_enhancement and must not recognize any Provider or vendor (e.g. Volcengine) implementation by name.
The enhance action never picks a Provider itself; it forwards the Host-frozen modelId/modelRoute to hostTools.videoEnhance and returns whatever that Host tool answers.
Completed output crosses only as the Host-issued canonical Asset handle the selected Provider executor's own single upload produced; this plugin never re-fetches a Provider URL.
Importing src/stdio.ts must never start enhancement or stdio serving.
